caveat: Readings are not comparable across ffmpeg builds: filter implementations and libvmaf model versions change between releases, and this project deliberately does not pin ffmpeg. Two reports from different builds are two different experiments.
what_this_is: The shipped ladder (veryfast/crf20) measured against the same filter graph at slow/crf12. Isolates the encode: both are the same picture. This is the number every O16/O17/O20 change is compared against.
